scope: Read-only diagnosis; no InDesign runtime available; original design and delivery unmodified by this audit.

relative_uri_evidence.qualification: Relative file URIs occur in existing SimpleIDML regression expected outputs. This is library evidence, not a fresh native InDesign runtime verification. Relative URI syntax alone is not evidence of the reported failure.

helper_limit.statement: PNG $ID/PNG token is conventional; available original helper says it was not verified using a native PNG fixture.

known_behavior: IDML contains an external Image/Link node referencing file:Links/cover_cutout.png. It does not carry the PNG image bytes as an embedded image payload. CanEmbed=true and AllowAutoEmbedding=true are capability/settings flags, not proof that embedding happened.
cause: Unproven. The old ZIP contains the correct image and IDML with exact bytes/case. Opening or moving the IDML separately, extraction/path resolution, or differences in InDesign import behavior could produce an unresolved link; no client-side reproduction establishes which occurred.
recommendation: Preserve the current document and its user edits. Deliver original latest IDML plus adjacent Links/cover_cutout.png and one repair JSX. Repair should resolve the source relative to its own script folder, relink/place into the existing cover image/frame, embed with native Link.unlink(), verify result, and save a user-selected .indd copy. Provide manual Links-panel relink/embed as fallback. Do not hand-invent an embedded IDML schema or claim runtime success without InDesign verification.
